description: This Java class defines an Android Activity called MessagingMainActivity, which is part of a sample app demonstrating notification styles on Wear OS. It includes logic to set up the activity view and cancel existing notifications, serving as a template for messaging app functionality.

classes.name: MessagingMainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that manages messaging notifications, primarily responsible for setting up the UI and cancelling notifications upon creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android lifecycle method invoked when the activity is created. Sets up the activity layout and cancels a notification with a specific ID.
